Just let me know what else you'd like to keep organized.

Yeah, I also looked into tickets for the Wicked IMAX re-release but I ended up not buying any. The only available showings were packed weekend evening slots and I really didn't want to deal with that. I'd much rather catch a quieter Tuesday afternoon screening if they add one later. Crowds at evening weekend showings stress me out honestly.

Understood — you passed on the Wicked IMAX tickets because the available showtimes were all crowded weekend evenings, which isn't your thing. If you hear about a weekday matinee slot opening, let me know and I can help you grab it quickly.

Actually wait — I need to fix something. I double-checked the receipt and the tickets were actually $179 each, not $187. So the total for both Hozier tickets is $358. I must have been thinking of a different purchase when I said $187. Sorry about that, just want the numbers to be right.

But that person bought their tickets through a reseller so the price was different from ours. Just an interesting comparison — resale prices are already above face value apparently.

That's interesting but not surprising — resale markups for popular shows start climbing quickly, especially as the date approaches. The $185 from that reseller purchase is a different transaction entirely from your direct purchase, so it wouldn't affect your actual charge. It does show there's strong demand for the show, which is a good sign for the atmosphere that night. Still, your actual per-ticket cost is what matters for your own tracking, so let's wait until you verify whether that retroactive fee applies to your specific order before changing anything.

Good point about the resale thing being separate. I'm also starting to lean toward buying the Bon Iver tickets soon rather than waiting for Dana. The lawn seats might sell out if I wait too long, and I'd hate to have another Knocked Loose situation. Maybe I'll just buy two and hope Dana confirms. Still thinking on it though.

Alright update on the fee situation — I just checked my credit card statement and the charge is still $179 per ticket, so the retroactive fee thing was wrong. Dana must have misread the Anthem's post or it applied to a different event. So we're back to $358 total for both Hozier tickets. Glad I checked before panicking about it.

That's a valid concern given your experience with the Knocked Loose sellout. Lawn seats for a summer Merriweather show can definitely move fast, especially for an act like Bon Iver. Buying two at $65 each and banking on Dana confirming is a reasonable hedge — $130 total isn't a huge risk even if she can't make it, since you could likely find someone else or resell the extra ticket. But I understand wanting to be sure before committing. You have until end of May for Dana's answer, so maybe set yourself a deadline a week or two before that to check availability.

Great news — glad you verified directly with your credit card statement. The Hozier tickets remain at $179 each, $358 total, just as you originally confirmed. Social media posts can be misleading, especially when they reference fees that might apply to different events or purchase windows. Your confirmed lineup stays the same: Hozier at the Anthem on May 10 with Dana, Ari Aster at Alamo Drafthouse on May 17, and Bon Iver at Merriweather on July 19 as a pending decision. Everything is squared away now.
